text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, my tummy's so happy! I'm getting
sleepy now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we have been running around a lot,
so I'm feeling a bit sleepy
too. But we've
still got a long ways to go!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought we'd be served
lunch during the audition? I
appreciate Ms.
Beauty's thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You can't have beauty without a healthy
diet!" I'm pretty picky about
what I eat, so
I couldn't agree more! ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, to all my lovely gems gathered in
this hall—please enjoy a
one-hour lunch
break on me!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
After all, you can't have beauty without a
healthy diet! Eat up, so you
can keep on
showing me your beauty in the afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You won't be allowed to leave the hall
during this time, but feel free to discuss
the riddle you're on with your team. Time
is beauty, as they
say!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
As of now, eighty percent of teams have
solved the first riddle—what's this? I'm
hearing that some teams have solved the

second riddle already!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Which means, it's time for me to explain
the final riddle! In the last
round, every
team will receive the same riddle to
solve.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of fairness, each team will
only get one attempt to solve this riddle.
You'll get ten minutes exactly, so
remember to watch the
clock.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Which of you gems will solve the final
riddle and get to propose to
your wedding
dress? I can hardly wait! ☆

text_block_list.name: Positive Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So some teams are already past the second
riddle... Still, we can't
give up now! We've
gotta show Ms. Beauty our grit!

text_block_list.name: Insecure Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Usually, I freeze up under
pressure... but this audition will be

different!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone... feels the same way Curren
does...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(They have a part of themselves they want
to show off...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Earth to Fine. Shouldn't we get to
cracking that riddle?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right, of course! My apologies for spacing
out just now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First things first, let me read the riddle
aloud again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Lift your gaze to the room containing
every number, for treasure
hides where the
beholder lies. The legend begins on your
marks."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Get set, go!"

text_block_list.name: Rice and Urara
text_block_list.text: "Oooh! Umadacchi! Oooh!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Umapyoi"—wait, ahhh! Sorry! The song's
just so catchy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, that's a great idea! Rice,
Urara,
could you pick up from
where you left
off? ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-you want me to sing? Um... "Uma
uma umya unya—3, 2, 1,
fight!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you add up the three, two, and one...
you get six!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the part of the riddle about
"containing every number" means
adding
up all the digits in the song?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you think about it, "Umapyoi Legend"
has a bunch of digits in its
lyrics. ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I get it now! In that case,
I'll sing the whole
song! "1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4, 5!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Slow down, Urara! Let's see, one
plus two... then three plus
four?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In the lyrics, "1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4,
5," the "4, 5" portion sticks out
noticeably from the first three placings.
Perhaps we don't need to add
them up?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see,
so there's a trick to it. Well then,
why don't we have you three
sing the rest
of the song together?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just to be clear, Curren and I will be
adding the numbers while you
three
handle the lyrics. We'll cross-check our
answers after.

text_block_list.name: Curren and Ikuno
text_block_list.text: The answer is room 109!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nice! ♪ By the way, solving this
riddle sure felt like a team
effort, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Like, we figured out the riddle thanks to
Urara and Rice singing...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And Fine's photographic memory of the
written lyrics saved us from
falling for the
riddle's trick and miscounting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget Ikuno's brilliant
suggestion of cross-checking the
calculations! ...Hehe,
we've come together quite nicely as a
team. ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"My splendorous gemstones! It's about
time for the afternoon
riddle-solving to
begin! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm gonna run to the bathroom real
quick! I'll catch up later, so go
ahead
without me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! ...Remember to watch where
you're going!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Gotta go! Gotta hurry! Can't fall behind!
Everyone's off to room
109! ♪

text_block_list.name: Elderly Guest
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, young lady... Sorry to bother
you.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Guest
text_block_list.text:
Might you know where the annex is? I'm
afraid I've lost my way back
to my room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You're lost? Don't worry—I'll
take you to your room!
